description: This file defines configuration classes and extension methods for setting up Azure Queue streaming in Orleans, including configurator interfaces, extension methods for configuration, and concrete configurator classes for silo and cluster client setups.

classes.name: AzureQueueStreamConfiguratorExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for configuring Azure Queue streaming.

classes.name: SiloAzureQueueStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator class for silo Azure Queue stream setup.

classes.name: ClusterClientAzureQueueStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator class for cluster client Azure Queue stream setup.

methods.name: ConfigureAzureQueue
methods.description: Configures Azure Queue options with provided options builder.

methods.name: ConfigureQueueDataAdapter
methods.description: Configures a queue data adapter using a factory function.

methods.name: ConfigureQueueDataAdapter<TQueueDataAdapter>
methods.description: Configures a specific queue data adapter type.

methods.name: ConfigureCacheSize
methods.description: Sets the cache size for silo Azure Queue stream configuration.
